messages:
Maria: dropping a quick thread on undo/confirm semantics for rollout actions. Mainly: Promote vs Rollback UX, undo window length, SR announcements, and copy. Figma: figma.com/... pls skim.
Jake: TL;DR: users want fast recovery but we must avoid accidental destructive ops. Two patterns: quick-action with short undo toast (8-12s) vs blocking confirm for destructive ops.
Sam: Agree. Suggest rule: Promote = quick-action + undo toast; Rollback/Revert = modal confirm for prod, quick-action with toast for non-prod. Also consider a "Soft rollback" that reroutes traffic but keeps version live.
Aisha: Accessibility: toasts need role="status" or role="alert"? For undo availability, role="status" (aria-live polite) avoids interrupting. But for destructive confirmation errors, use role="alert". Also keyboard focus: when modal opens, trap focus, focus heading, aria-describedby for typed-confirm instructions.
Priya: copy: Toast copy for promote: "Promoted Variant B to 20%." CTA: "Undo". For rollback toast: "Rollback applied to Variant A. Undo available." Keep short for translation. Do not use verbs like "move" in tooltips.
Lee: Undo window debate: 8s vs 15s. Metrics team prefers longer to detect regressions but UX team worries about clutter. Propose dynamic undo: default 10s, extendable to 30s in slow networks or when metrics show high traffic. But that adds complexity.
Tom: ops requirement: any rollback must create an audit entry immediately and include operation id in toast/link. If undo is used, that should also be audited as a separate op. Toast should link to the audit: "View details".
Maria: technical constraints: undo should be a server-side reversal (idempotent op) not just UI flip. We'll add an " Undo token " valid for N seconds. Also display operation ID in toast for traceability.
Jake: Keyboard: toast undo must be reachable via keyboard (Tab focuses toast, Enter triggers Undo). Also SR: announce "Promote completed. Undo available for 10 seconds" via aria-live polite. When undo clicked, announce "Undo requested" and then "Undo complete" or an error.
Aisha: For screenreader users who miss the toast, we should provide an audit panel list in the details flyout with recent actions and quick-undo only if still within time window. That way SR users have parity.
Sam: Edge case: concurrent ops. If a promote is in-flight and user attempts another change, disable conflicting controls and show tooltip "Another operation is pending (op id: xyz)". If undo wins, update status. Display pending skeletons.
Priya: internationalization: avoid time-relative phrases in toast like "in 10s" translate poorly. Use seconds numerically: "Undo available for 10 seconds". Also keep CTA single-word when possible.
Lee: microcopy nuance: ''Undo'' vs ''Revert''. For consistency, use "Undo" for immediate reversal of the last action, and "Revert to snapshot" for historical reverts. Document in glossary.
Tom: security: typed-confirm for reverts in prod only. Use pattern: "Type REVERT" and check locale casing (use uppercase) in validation. Also require 2FA/approval for large-scale reverts per policy.
Maria: motion & contrast: undo toast should respect prefers-reduced-motion. Toast color needs 4.5:1 contrast with text; when on dark bg use a bordered card. Also ensure toast doesn't cover critical controls or overlap timeline.
Jake: telemetry: emit events for action, undo-available, undo-clicked, undo-expired, and final-state. Surfaces: UI, audit logs, and metrics. Include op-id.
Aisha: SR flow when undo expires: announce "Undo expired" and ensure persistent audit item still accessible. For screenreader undo list, provide clear timestamps and operation ids.
Sam: question on UX: Should we allow stacked undos? e.g., promote A->B then B->C quickly and allow undoing last two in order. That complicates semantics. Suggest single-level undo only.
Priya: agree single-level undo reduces confusion. For multi-step, use an explicit Revert flow with modal.
Maria: action items: - Promote = quick-action + 10s undo toast + aria-live polite announcements - Rollback/Revert = modal confirm in prod (typed-confirm) + quick toast in non-prod - toast includes op-id + link to audit - toast keyboard focusable & SR-accessible + audit panel parity - disable conflicting actions when op pending - single-level undo only - telemetry events + docs for i18n + reduced-motion/contrast checks - update Figma + component code + add glossary entry.
designbot: Design review requested by Maria for `undo-confirmation-semantics`. Reviewers: Jake, Aisha, Sam, Priya, Lee, Tom. Deadline: 3 business days. :spiral_calendar:
Maria: thanks all. I'll push mocks and a short implementation note with aria examples and the event schema. Ping here when you review the tokens or have objections to 10s default.
